purpose: Address the supervisor's methodological and reproducibility comments before JMBE submission.

analysis_status.all_new_analyses: exploratory and post hoc relative to the original study
known_before_this_freeze: The corrected Route A cross-task and Arithmetic LOSO results had already been inspected.
The earlier random-window versus recording-disjoint logistic-regression leakage audit had already been inspected.
The S4 numerical anomaly and the corrected bounded CB-SF outputs had already been inspected.
not_yet_inspected_at_this_freeze: The extended participant-disjoint result in the matched three-split audit.
Stroop LOSO results under the mirrored Route A protocol.

three_split_audit.binary_labels: natural and low = 0; medium and high = 1

recording_disjoint.folds: two balanced folds; each validation fold contains one recording from each binary class

participant_disjoint.scope: within each task across all participants

three_split_audit.seed_policy: split repeats are averaged within participant and are never treated as independent inferential samples
three_split_audit.interpretation_limit: participant-disjoint evaluation changes the target population and training-set size, so its difference from recording-disjoint evaluation is not attributed solely to window leakage

noninferiority_sensitivity.status: exploratory margin analysis, not a confirmatory non-inferiority trial
noninferiority_sensitivity.decision_rule: report whether the lower interval endpoint exceeds the negative margin; do not select a preferred margin after seeing results

direction_specific_cross_task.source: existing frozen recording-level Route A predictions

stroop_loso.inner_split: participant-disjoint and fully nested within each outer-training set
stroop_loso.models_and_hyperparameters: identical to the frozen Arithmetic LOSO Route A protocol
stroop_loso.methods: the same 14 methods reported for Arithmetic LOSO
stroop_loso.selection_rule: no result-dependent retuning after this protocol freeze

preprocessing_sensitivity.factual_correction: 2125-sample windows use a 4096-point zero-padded FFT in the actual frozen code, not a 2048-point FFT
variants: standardize each continuous recording before windowing instead of standardizing each window
set 50-Hz spectral attenuation multiplier from 0.03 to 1.0
set legacy feature multipliers 1.12 and 1.10 to 1.0
preprocessing_sensitivity.interpretation: sensitivity analysis only; no variant will replace the reference based on superior accuracy

final_reproducibility.prediction_freeze: create a new versioned freeze after all planned analyses; never overwrite the Route A freeze
required_outputs: public repository URL and archived DOI
